steps.content: You find yourself in a wasteland, a withered rose in the distance, singing faintly.

steps.speaker: Rose Flower
steps.content: Ahead, it might be an abyss, or it could be a hair-raising nightmare...

steps.speaker: Rose Flower
steps.content: Keep going, hero, this is the last hope.
Looking into the distance, you see a familiar figure—Mess.
Mess is clad in armor, her hand holding the giant sword trembling slightly, it's unclear whether she's excited or nervous. In front of her, is a dragon with black scales and blood-red eyes.

steps.speaker: Rose Flower
steps.content: The hero is exhausted, she's finally found the embodiment of fear—the evil dragon that brings calamity and suffering!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: This is really interesting... Die, evil dragon! I swear on my sword, today I will cut off the source of all evil!
Mess exerts all her strength, slaying the dragon with her sword. The dragon lets out a mournful cry, its body turns into black smoke and scatters with the wind.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The horrifying black thing is gone... It's all over now.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Now, it's my new era! Hahahaha!
A huge shadow appears on Mess's back, it seems to be... a pair of dragon wings!
The rose timidly lowers its head.

steps.speaker: Rose Flower
steps.content: The one who defeated fear, has become a greater fear for all...

steps.speaker: Rose Flower
steps.content: A storm is coming, a new evil dragon has been born! The world is trembling. We are about to enter an even more terrifying dark age!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ahahaha! The one who's peeking over there, yes, I'm calling you!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You wanna be the next dragon slayer? Are you a hero?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, I'm busy right now. But when you're done, find us at the exit.
